'''Detoxify Poison''',<ref name="RPG" /> or '''Cure Poison''',<ref name="LOTF">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> was a [[Force power/Legends#Control|Control]]-based [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to detoxify [[Poison/Legends|poisons]] or eject them from their body in a much shorter amount of [[Time/Legends|time]] than would normally be possible. It could also be used to cleanse their body of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]], allowing the individual to remain sober while consuming vast amounts of the drink.<ref name="RPG" /> The power typically required extended concentration by the user and was limited to only removing the present and future effects of the poisons in one's system; past damage was not healed.<ref name="LOTF" />

While commonly associated with the Jedi and their practice of the light side,<ref name="Jedi Path" /> this ability was not the exclusive domain of those who clung to the light. During a meeting with [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] made use of this power to rid himself of the [[Karatos Plague]] that Fett had used to poison him.<ref name="JF OS 4">[[Jango Fett: Open Seasons 4|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'' 4]]</ref> [[Cade Skywalker]] used this power to resist the [[Ixetal cilona/Legends|Ixetal cilona]] administered by [[Darth Maladi]]. Maladi later commented that the power was similar to powers used by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="L15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref> Indeed, Darth Sidious knew [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith Magic]] to defeat poison,<ref name="DPN">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> and had to use this power when he was poisoned with Aorth-6 during the Gentis Coup in the same year he became Emperor.<ref name="Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 2">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 2|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 2]]</ref>
